meta.title: SoL-dsh Efficiency Pack
meta.description: Opt-in efficiency mechanisms ported from NVlabs/SoL-Pi: Action Fusion (run a follow-up command after edit/write), ObservationPack (archive large results and recall them by page), Evidence-Preserving Reducer (turn build/test logs into verbatim-checkable receipts), and Online Context Compact (compaction at plan boundaries). All mechanisms are off by default.
